client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx.name: Sign-in state

client/src/contexts/FormContext.tsx.name: Form answers in progress
client/src/contexts/FormContext.tsx.description: Holds what someone has filled in so far and decides which follow-up questions to show.

client/src/contexts/KeyboardContext.tsx.name: Keyboard shortcuts

client/src/contexts/OrgScopeContext.tsx.name: Chosen organization
client/src/contexts/OrgScopeContext.tsx.description: Remembers which organization's records the staff member is currently looking at.

client/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx.name: Light and dark display
client/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx.description: Remembers whether someone prefers the light or dark look and keeps that choice between visits.

client/src/hooks/executionHistoryCache.t.name: Live run history

client/src/hooks/useAgentRunUpdates.ts.name: Live agent run updates
client/src/hooks/useAgentRunUpdates.ts.description: Refreshes an agent run on screen as soon as the server reports new progress.

client/src/hooks/useAgents.ts.name: AI agents
client/src/hooks/useAgents.ts.description: Lists, creates, edits and retires AI agents, including the tools and helpers each one may use.

client/src/hooks/useAppCodeUpdates.ts.name: Live app code

client/src/hooks/useAppDependencies.ts.name: App add-on libraries

client/src/hooks/useApplications.ts.name: Apps
client/src/hooks/useApplications.ts.description: Creates, builds, publishes, exports and deletes the apps people use in the workspace.

client/src/hooks/useApplicationSdkUpdate.name: App update progress
client/src/hooks/useApplicationSdkUpdate.description: Tracks the background work that brings apps onto the latest platform tooling.

client/src/hooks/useAppLiveUpdates.ts.name: Live app preview

client/src/hooks/useAssignEntityRole.ts.name: Add a role

client/src/hooks/useAuditLog.ts.name: Activity history
client/src/hooks/useAuditLog.ts.description: Shows the record of who did what, groups it, and re-checks access decisions made in the past.

client/src/hooks/useAutoMatch.ts.name: Records found by name
client/src/hooks/useAutoMatch.ts.description: Suggests matches between records by comparing their names and values.

client/src/hooks/useAutoReload.ts.name: Reload on change
client/src/hooks/useAutoReload.ts.description: Reloads a list automatically when the chosen organization or filters change.

client/src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts.name: Automatic saving
client/src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts.description: Saves edits in the background as people work so nothing is lost when they move on.

client/src/hooks/useBifrostMonacoTheme.t.name: Editor colours
client/src/hooks/useBifrostMonacoTheme.t.description: Keeps every code editing panel matching the current light or dark display setting.

client/src/hooks/useBranding.ts.description: Loads and changes the logo, main colour and application name shown across the platform.

client/src/hooks/useChat.ts.name: Chat conversations
client/src/hooks/useChat.ts.description: Starts conversations with an AI agent, loads past messages and sends new ones.

client/src/hooks/useChatAvailability.ts.name: Chat availability
client/src/hooks/useChatAvailability.ts.description: Tells screens whether the chat assistant is ready to use.

client/src/hooks/useChatStream.ts.name: Live chat replies
client/src/hooks/useChatStream.ts.description: Streams an AI agent's answer into the chat window as it is written and keeps it if the page reloads.

client/src/hooks/useCollectionOrder.ts.name: Personal list order
client/src/hooks/useCollectionOrder.ts.description: Remembers the order one person arranged a collection's items in, on this browser only.

client/src/hooks/useComparisonLayout.ts.name: Side-by-side code view
client/src/hooks/useComparisonLayout.ts.description: Gives two code versions a comfortable side-by-side view inside a comparison panel.

client/src/hooks/useConfig.ts.name: Connected service settings
client/src/hooks/useConfig.ts.description: Reads and saves the stored settings that connect the platform to outside services.

client/src/hooks/useDashboardMetrics.ts.name: Dashboard numbers
client/src/hooks/useDashboardMetrics.ts.description: Loads the headline counts and figures shown on the dashboard.

client/src/hooks/useDependencyGraph.ts.name: What depends on what
client/src/hooks/useDependencyGraph.ts.description: Maps which workflows, forms and apps rely on an item before someone changes or deletes it.

client/src/hooks/useDialogReturnFocus.ts.name: Focus after closing

client/src/hooks/useEditorSession.ts.name: Editor session memory

client/src/hooks/useEventStream.ts.name: Incoming events
client/src/hooks/useEventStream.ts.description: Streams new events from connected services into the event list as they arrive.

client/src/hooks/useExecutions.ts.name: Workflow runs
client/src/hooks/useExecutions.ts.description: Lists workflow runs, follows a running one until it ends, and lets staff cancel it.

client/src/hooks/useExecutionStream.ts.name: Live run tracking

client/src/hooks/useExecutionTimeSeries..name: Run volume chart
client/src/hooks/useExecutionTimeSeries..description: Supplies the numbers behind the chart of how many workflow runs happened over a period.

client/src/hooks/useFieldManager.ts.name: Form field editing
client/src/hooks/useFieldManager.ts.description: Adds, reorders, changes and removes the questions on a form.

client/src/hooks/useFileActivity.ts.name: Who else is editing

client/src/hooks/useFileLoader.ts.name: Opening files safely

client/src/hooks/useFileTree.ts.name: File tree state
client/src/hooks/useFileTree.ts.description: Keeps the workspace file tree's open folders and loaded contents.

client/src/hooks/useFileTreeActions.ts.description: Creates, renames, moves, deletes and uploads workspace files, and confirms clashes before overwriting.

client/src/hooks/useFormFileUpload.ts.name: Form file uploads
client/src/hooks/useFormFileUpload.ts.description: Uploads files attached to a form, showing progress and checking size and type first.
